purpose: Define explicit rotation/revocation of authentication credentials and keys without changing the underlying IdentityCore identity.

topics.name: IAM Credential Rotation
topics.purpose: Define explicit rotation/revocation of authentication credentials and keys without changing the underlying IdentityCore identity.

semantics.rotation_rule: New credential/key is activated only through explicit authenticated/authorized rotation operation.
semantics.revocation_rule: Superseded/revoked credential becomes invalid according to explicit state.
semantics.resource_rule: Resource-specific reauthentication may rotate keys/credentials according to its owning policy.
semantics.session_rule: Existing sessions may remain, downgrade or terminate according to explicit session policy; no silent assumption.
semantics.provenance_rule: Rotation event records identity, credential class, authority and time without exposing secret material.
semantics.secret_rule: Secret values are not emitted into ordinary logs/provenance.

invariants.rule: Identity lifecycle, authentication assurance, credential state and session state remain explicit and cannot be inferred from authorization, transport or profile data.

hard_gates.condition: credential rotation creates new semantic identity
secret material written to ordinary logs

references.purpose: Resource reauth may require credential/key rotation.
